explanation: To be immersed in water as an outward sign of inner cleansing, identification with Jesus' death and resurrection, and entry into the new community of life.
Humanity's violation of God's will; a power or dominion that leads to spiritual death and separation from God.
To be released from sin's compulsive dominion, so that one is no longer its slave but free to serve righteousness.
The title for Jesus that acknowledges his divine authority and sovereignty over all things; the One who has full power over life and death.
Something given without merit or payment, especially God's grace that grants eternal life through faith in Christ rather than by works.
Eternal life as a gift from God to those who believe; a new level of existence characterized by holiness and fellowship with Jesus.
